This application ("TODO") is committed to protecting your privacy. Please read this policy to understand how your information is handled.

1. Information Collection
• This app does not collect, store, or transmit any personal data.
• All tasks and data are stored locally on your device only.
• No analytics, ads, or third-party tracking are used.

2. Permissions
• The app may request notification permission to provide you with task reminders. This is optional and only used for local notifications.
• No other sensitive permissions are required or used.

3. Data Sharing
• Your data is not shared with any third parties.
• No data is uploaded, sold, or transferred outside of your device.

4. Children's Privacy
• This app is suitable for all ages and does not collect information from children under 13.

5. Security
• Your data is securely stored on your device. For additional security, use your device's PIN, fingerprint, or other security features.

6. Contact
• If you have any questions or concerns about this privacy policy, please contact the developer at support@mamunwrites.com.

By using this app, you agree to this privacy policy. The policy may be updated from time to time. Please review it periodically.
